title: Endelurgy
description: Adds new ores, resources and improves upon the End
body:
![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1262008/description_36631200-3799-460b-b420-0cf67aa66347.png)

## Overview:

Endelurgy is a mod that expands upon the barren wasteland of the End by enhancing the terrain with new blocks - Voidslate and Noxrock, and adding 3 new resources: Adamantite, Luxite and Enderite.

Voidslate covers the bottom half of End islands and can bear ores. It's tougher than End Stone and can be used to make a variety of building blocks.

Noxrock generates within the Voidslate layer, and creates a toxic cloud when broken which inflicts Corrosion - an effect that saps the durability of all equipped armor and tools. It's tough to mine, but susceptible to explosions. Noxrock can be used to craft a variety of building blocks, as well as the Dirty Bomb - TNT variant that creates a lingering toxic cloud instead of destroying blocks. 

Adamantite is a tough metal that can be used to make a tier of equipment between Diamond and Netherite, or brewed into potions of Vitality - which provide the Health Boost effect.

Luxite is a bright blast-resistant gem that can only be found in Noxrock, and can be brewed into potions of Restoration - an effect that repairs all equipped tools and armor.

Enderite is an alloy made of Adamantite and Luxite, and serves as a direct upgrade to Netherite. Tools and weapons made of Enderite are stronger, faster and more durable, while the armor also has several unique traits, such as additional protection from most damage types, or allowing for armored flight.

## Compatibility:

[**Alex's Caves**](https://modrinth.com/mod/alexs-caves) - enderite/galena gauntlet compatibility

[**Create**](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) - compatibility recipes, crushed raw adamantite

[**Quark**](https://modrinth.com/mod/quark) - compatibility recipes, hoe harvesting

[**Spelunkery**](https://modrinth.com/mod/spelunkery) - compatibility recipes, blocks and items (requires custom datapack for ore drops)

[**Farmer's Delight**](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) - adamantite and enderite knives

[**Clayworks**](https://modrinth.com/mod/clayworks) - decorated pot trim textures
